panels.title: Telegrams per device over time
panels.description: How chatty is each device? A sensor which suddenly stops or floods stands out here.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.device_name, set: ${device:json}) or ${device:json}[0] == "$__all")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["device_name", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["device_name"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["device_name", "address"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 25)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ device: if exists r.device_name and r.device_name != "" then r.device_name else r.address, telegrams: r._value }))

panels.title: Per device: count, first and last telegram
panels.description: Sorted by traffic. 'last' shows when the device was heard from the last time.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["device_name", "address", "eep", "area"])
  |> reduce(identity: {telegrams: 0, last: time(v: 0)},
            fn: (r, accumulator) => ({ telegrams: accumulator.telegrams + 1,
                                       last: if r._time > accumulator.last then r._time else accumulator.last }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["telegrams"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "count")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["platform"])

panels.title: Average interval between two telegrams
panels.description: A battery sensor with a very long interval may have an empty battery; a very short one floods the bus.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["device_name", "address"])
  |> elapsed(unit: 1s)
  |> mean(column: "elapsed")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["elapsed"])
  |> rename(columns: {elapsed: "avg seconds between telegrams"})
